name: Temptation 2
source:
Makoto Agata is a school physician. As part of psychologic treatment, he studies hypno therapy, and finds that his voice and accent have something unusual which affects the mental state of his patients. There is a girl who often appears at his sickroom, her name is Sayaka Kusumiya...

[Slightly edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024695]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名校医。为了进行心理治疗，他开始研究催眠疗法，并发现自己的声音和语调具有某种异常特质，能够影响患者的精神状态。保健室里有一名经常来访的女孩，名叫楠宫沙耶香……

[根据 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024695]DLsite English[/url]略作修改]
